        <!-- ── CALL FOR PAPERS ── -->
        <h2 id="cfp">Call for Papers</h2>
        <p>
          IEEE AFRICON 2027 invites submissions of original, unpublished research papers from researchers, engineers, and practitioners from universities, industry, and research institutions worldwide. The conference theme is <em>"Harnessing Emerging Technologies for Africa's sustainable development"</em>.
        </p>

        <!-- ── PAPER SUBMISSION ── -->
        <h2 id="submission" style="margin-top:36px;">Paper Submission</h2>
        <p>
          All papers must be submitted electronically through the <strong>Microsoft CMT</strong> paper management system. Submitted papers must be original work not previously published or currently under review for any other conference or journal.
        </p>
        <p>
          Papers should be written in English and must comply with the IEEE two-column format. The maximum paper length is <strong>8 pages</strong> (including references). Authors may purchase up to 2 additional pages at an extra charge.
        </p>
        <a href="https://cmt3.research.microsoft.com/AFRICON2027/Submission/Index" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="btn-primary" style="color:#fff !important;background:#006699 !important;text-decoration:none !important;"><i class="fa fa-upload" style="color:#fff !important;"></i> &nbsp; <span style="color:#fff !important;">Submit Your Paper via CMT</span></a>

        <!-- ── AUTHOR GUIDELINES ── -->
        <h2 id="guidelines" style="margin-top:36px;">Author Guidelines</h2>
        <h3>Paper Format</h3>
        <ul>
          <li>Papers must be formatted using the IEEE two-column conference template.</li>
          <li>Use the official <a href="https://template-selector.ieee.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">IEEE conference template selector</a> for Microsoft Word or LaTeX.</li>
          <li>Maximum length: 8 pages including all figures, tables, and references.</li>
          <li>Up to 2 additional pages may be purchased during registration.</li>
          <li>All submissions must be in PDF format.</li>
        </ul>
        <h3>Review Process</h3>
        <p>
          All papers will undergo double-anonymous peer review by a minimum of
          two independent reviewers. Authors must remove names, affiliations,
          acknowledgements and other identifying information from the review
          manuscript. Reviewers and committee members must declare conflicts of
          interest; conflicted reviewers will not be assigned to the paper.
          Submissions will also be screened for similarity and publication
          ethics concerns before a final decision is made.
        </p>
        <p>
          Accepted authors must submit the final paper through the announced
          camera-ready workflow, complete the IEEE electronic Copyright Form
          (eCF), and provide an IEEE Xplore-compliant PDF. The conference's PDF
          eXpress or PDF Checker instructions and conference ID will be issued
          with acceptance notifications. See
          <a href="https://conferences.ieeeauthorcenter.ieee.org/write-your-paper/meet-ieee-xplore-requirements/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">IEEE Xplore PDF requirements</a>.
        </p>
        <h3>Publication</h3>
        <p>
          Papers accepted and presented in accordance with the conference
          presentation policy will be submitted to IEEE for consideration for
          inclusion in IEEE Xplore. Acceptance does not guarantee publication
          or indexing. At least one author of each accepted paper must register
          and present the work. The conference is currently planned as an
          in-person event; any virtual participation option will be announced
          only after approval.
        </p>
